Poach the chicken: Put the chicken in a small pan, cover it with cold water and bring to a gentle simmer. Cook for 12 to 15 minutes. Wash your hands and the board after touching raw chicken.

Prepare the bananas: Peel the bananas and break them into chunks. The riper they are, the sweeter the drink.

Prepare the broccoli: As soon as the tray is in, boil the kettle. Wash the broccoli and cut it into florets about 6 cm long, keeping a long piece of stalk on each.
Prepare the broccoli: While it roasts, cut the broccoli into small florets.
Prepare the broccoli: While the pasta cooks, cut the broccoli into small florets. Grate the cheddar.
Prepare the cabbage and chestnuts: Quarter the red cabbage, cut out the hard white core and slice it into thin strips. Leave the chestnuts whole, or halve any big ones.
Prepare the cheese and lettuce: Grate the cheddar on the coarse side of a grater. Rinse the lettuce and shake it dry, keeping the leaves whole and tearing only very big ones in half.
Prepare the cheese and spinach: Grate the cheese on the coarse side of the grater. Rinse the spinach under cold water and shake it dry, unless the bag says it's ready washed.
Prepare the cheese and spinach: While the pasta cooks, grate the cheddar finely and rinse the spinach in a colander.

Prepare the cheese and tomatoes: Grate the cheddar on the large holes of the grater and set about a third aside for the top. Wash the tomatoes, cut out any hard core and slice them about as thick as a pound coin.

Prepare the chicken and mushrooms: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces, about 2 cm across, and pat them dry with kitchen paper. Wash your hands, the knife and the board in hot soapy water. Wipe the mushrooms clean and slice them thickly, about 1 cm.
Prepare the chicken: Cut each chicken breast almost in half sideways and open it out like a book, so it is thin and even. Wash your hands, the board and the knife after touching raw chicken.
Prepare the chicken: Slice each chicken breast in half sideways, so it is thin and cooks evenly. Wash your hands, the board and the knife after touching raw chicken.

Prepare the chickpeas and potatoes: Drain the chickpeas in a sieve and rinse them, then drain the potatoes. Pat both dry on a clean tea towel or kitchen paper so they turn golden. Cut the potatoes in half, or into quarters if very big.
Prepare the cucumber: Cut the cucumber into 1 cm chunks and slice the spring onions into thin rings. Put both in a bowl.
Prepare the filling: Grate the cheddar on the coarse side of a grater. Slice the spring onions into thin rings. Fold each ham slice in half.
Prepare the filling: Grate the cheddar on to a plate. Tear the ham into pieces about 2 cm across and put them beside the cheese.
Prepare the filling: Grate the cheese. Trim the spring onions and slice them thinly into rings, about as thick as a pound coin.
Prepare the fruit: Cut the apples into quarters, cut out the cores and chop them into small pieces. Mix them with the berries and half the cinnamon in a small baking dish.
Prepare the gammon: Meanwhile, pat the gammon dry. Snip the fat at the edge in a few places with scissors to stop it curling.
Prepare the lettuce and cheese: Rinse the lettuce, shake it dry and keep the leaves whole, tearing any very big ones in half. Grate the cheddar on the coarse side of the grater. Set both aside.
Prepare the lettuce and cheese: Rinse the lettuce, shake it dry and shred it into thin strips. Grate the cheddar on the coarse side of the grater.
Prepare the lettuce: Meanwhile, wash the lettuce, shake it dry and cut or tear it into bite-sized pieces. Grate the cheddar.
Prepare the mushrooms: Wipe the mushrooms with damp kitchen paper and slice them from top to stalk, about 6 mm thick. Slice the spring onions on a slant and set them aside.

Turn the chicken: Turn the strips and fry for 2 minutes more, until golden on the other side. Lift them on to a plate, add the rest of the oil and brown the rest of the chicken the same way.
Turn the chicken: Turn the strips and fry for 2 to 3 minutes more, until browned on the other side too.
Turn the chicken: Turn the strips and fry for 2 to 3 minutes more, until golden brown on the other side too.
Turn the chicken: Turn the strips and fry for 2 to 3 minutes more, until golden on the other side too.

Turn the chicken: Turn the strips and fry for 3 to 4 minutes more, turning now and then, until golden and charred in places.

Turn the chicken: Turn the strips over and fry for 2 to 3 minutes more, until golden on the other side too.

Turn the chicken: Turn the thighs and cook for 5 to 6 minutes more, pressing them flat, until deep golden, piping hot and no pink is left in the middle. Leave them on a board for 2 minutes, then slice across.

Wilt the spinach: Rinse the spinach unless the bag says it is ready washed. Put it in a large pan on a medium heat with a splash of water and stir for 2 minutes, until soft.

Wilt the spinach: Rinse the spinach unless the bag says it is ready washed. Stir it in the hot bacon pan for 1 minute, until just soft. Tip it into a sieve, press out the water with a spoon and chop it.

Wilt the spinach: Stir in the spinach a handful at a time and cook for 2 minutes, until wilted.

Wilt the spinach: Stir in the spinach a handful at a time for 1 to 2 minutes, until it has shrunk down. Take the pan off the heat and stir in the lemon juice and a good grind of black pepper.
Wilt the spinach: Stir in the spinach a handful at a time for 1 to 2 minutes, until wilted. Tip everything into an ovenproof dish and spread it out.
Wilt the spinach: Stir in the spinach a handful at a time until it wilts, and add some black pepper.
Wilt the spinach: Stir in the spinach a handful at a time until it wilts, then take the pan off the heat and stir in the lemon juice.
Wilt the spinach: Stir in the spinach a handful at a time, letting each handful wilt before adding the next. This takes 1 to 2 minutes.
Wilt the spinach: Stir in the spinach a handful at a time, until it wilts.
Wilt the spinach: Stir in the spinach and cook for 1 minute, until it wilts. Stir in the lemon juice, a pinch of salt and some black pepper.
Wilt the spinach: Stir in the spinach and half the salsa for 1 minute, until the spinach wilts.
Wilt the spinach: Stir in the spinach for 1 minute, until it wilts. Season with salt and black pepper and take the pan off the heat.
Wilt the spinach: Stir in the spinach for 1 to 2 minutes, until it wilts, and add some black pepper.
Wilt the spinach: Stir in the spinach for about 1 minute, until it wilts.
Wilt the spinach: Stir in the spinach until it wilts, then take the pan off the heat and stir in the lemon juice and some black pepper.
Wilt the spinach: Stir in the spinach until it wilts, then take the pan off the heat and stir in the lemon juice.
Wilt the spinach: Stir in the spinach until it wilts. Spoon the hash onto plates and keep it warm.
Wilt the spinach: Stir the spinach in the frying pan for about 1 minute, until wilted and dark green, then lift it onto a plate.
Wilt the spinach: Stir the spinach into the beans for 1 to 2 minutes, until soft and dark green. Add a good grind of black pepper.
Wilt the spinach: Stir the spinach into the beans for about 1 minute, until it wilts.
